category.reason: Convert 2 p.m. to 14:00, locate the corresponding train, and verify that its 18:35 arrival is before 8 p.m.; the departure time alone uniquely identifies this row.

instruction.en: Choose a ticket for a train departing at 2 p.m. and arriving before 8 p.m.
instruction.zh: 选择20点之前到达的、14点出发的车票

reference.patch: The previous category.reason claimed that both time conditions were needed to identify the train and that a single field was insufficient. In the screenshot, 14:00 is the only departure matching 2 p.m.; that train arrives at 18:35, so the before-8-p.m. condition confirms the match but does not eliminate another candidate. Rewrote category.reason to describe the 12-hour to 24-hour conversion and the arrival-time check accurately. Only the category rationale changed; category.item remains Reasoning, and the instructions and groundTruth are unchanged.
